definitions.ROSE: A beautiful flower of the genus Rosa, typically with thorns and sweet fragrance.
definitions.LILY: A large, bell-shaped flower growing from a bulb.
definitions.DAISY: A flower with white petals and a yellow center.
definitions.POPPY: Any plant of the genus Papaver or the family Papaveraceae, with crumpled, often red, petals and a milky juice having narcotic properties.
definitions.LOTUS: An aquatic plant with large, beautiful flowers, representing purity.
definitions.PHLOX: Any flowering plant of the genus Phlox.
definitions.PEONY: A large, rounded flower with many layers of petals.
definitions.ASTER: Any of several plants of the genus Aster.
definitions.IRIS: A plant of the genus Iris, common in the northern hemisphere, and generally having attractive blooms (See Iris (plant)).
definitions.ORCHID: An exotic, highly evolved flower with colorful, three-petaled blooms.
definitions.VIOLET: A small, delicate purple or blue flower.
definitions.PANSY: A cultivated flowering plant, derived by hybridization within species Viola tricolor.
definitions.CROCUS: A perennial flowering plant (of the genus Crocus in the Iridaceae family).
definitions.AZALEA: A plant of the obsolete genus Azalea.
definitions.LUPINE: Any member of the genus Lupinus in the family Fabaceae.
definitions.ZINNIA: Any of several brightly coloured flowering plants, of the genus Zinnia, native to tropical America; old maid.
definitions.DAHLIA: Any plant of the genus Dahlia, tuberous perennial flowering plants native to Mexico.
definitions.PETUNIA: Any of the flowering plants of genus Petunia, of which most garden varieties are hybrids.
definitions.JASMINE: A sweet-scented white or yellow flower used in perfumes.
definitions.LILAC: A large shrub of the genus Syringa, especially Syringa vulgaris, bearing white, pale-pink or purple flowers.
definitions.HEATHER: An evergreen plant, Calluna vulgaris, with spiky leaves and small purple, pink, or white flowers.
definitions.CLOVER: A plant of the genus Trifolium with leaves usually divided into three (rarely four) leaflets and with white or red flowers.
definitions.YARROW: Any of several pungent Eurasian and North American herbs, of the genus Achillea, used in traditional herbal medicine.
definitions.MALLOW: Any of a group of flowering plants in several genera of the taxonomic family Malvaceae, especially of the genus Malva.
definitions.THISTLE: Any of several perennial composite plants, especially of genera Cirsium, Carduus, Cynara, or Onopordum, having prickly leaves and showy flower heads with prickly bracts.
definitions.NETTLE: Any plant whose foliage is covered with stinging, mildly poisonous hairs, causing an instant rash.
definitions.FERN: Any of a group of some twenty thousand species of vascular plants classified in the division Pteridophyta that lack seeds and reproduce by shedding spores to initiate an alternation of generations.
definitions.MOSS: Any of various small, green, seedless plants growing on the ground or on the surfaces of trees, stones, etc.
definitions.BLOOM: A blossom; the flower of a plant; an expanded bud.
definitions.PETAL: One of the component parts of the corolla of a flower.
definitions.LEAF: The usually green and flat organ that represents the most prominent feature of most vegetative plants.
definitions.BUD: A newly sprouted leaf or blossom that has not yet unfolded.
definitions.SEED: A fertilized and ripened ovule, containing an embryonic plant.
definitions.ROOT: The part of a plant, generally underground, that anchors and supports the plant body, absorbs and stores water and nutrients, and in some plants is able to perform vegetative reproduction.
definitions.SOIL: A mixture of mineral particles and organic material, used to support plant growth.
definitions.GARDEN: An outdoor area containing one or more types of plants, usually plants grown for food or ornamental purposes.
definitions.FLOWER: A colorful, conspicuous structure associated with angiosperms, frequently scented and attracting various insects, and which may or may not be used for sexual reproduction.
definitions.SPRING: To weaken, as a joint, ligament, or muscle, by sudden and excessive exertion, as by wrenching.
definitions.SUMMER: One of four seasons, traditionally the second, marked by the longest and typically hottest days of the year due to the inclination of the Earth and thermal lag.
definitions.NATURE: The physical world and everything in it, including plants, animals, and landscapes.
definitions.BRIGHT: An artist's brush used in oil and acrylic painting with a long ferrule and a flat, somewhat tapering bristle head.
definitions.FRAGRANT: Sweet-smelling; having a pleasant (usually strong) scent or fragrance.
definitions.COLOR: The spectral composition of visible light.
definitions.BEAUTY: The quality of being (especially visually) attractive, pleasing, fine or good-looking; comeliness.
definitions.WILD: The undomesticated state of a wild animal.
definitions.FIELD: A land area free of woodland, cities, and towns; open country.
definitions.SUNFLOWER: A tall plant with a large, golden-yellow flower head that turns toward the sun.
definitions.MARIGOLD: (genericised brand name, usually plural, sometimes with capital) A rubber glove, especially one for use in household cleaning.
definitions.LAVENDER: A soothing purple flower known for its calming aroma.
definitions.BEGONIA: Any plant of the large genus of Begonia.
definitions.CAMELLIA: Any plant of the genus Camellia, shrubs and small trees native to Asia; Camellia japonica is the most popular as a garden plant; Camellia sinensis is the tea plant.
definitions.GARDENIA: Any of various tropical evergreen small trees or shrubs, of the genus Gardenia, having glossy leaves and white flowers.
definitions.HIBISCUS: A flower of the genus Hibiscus, especially Hibiscus syriacus, found in tropical to temperate regions, of some species used for making infusions/tea.
definitions.HYACINTH: Any bulbous plant of the genus Hyacinthus, native to the Mediterranean and South Africa.
definitions.MAGNOLIA: A tree or shrub in any species of the genus Magnolia, many with large flowers and simple leaves.
definitions.NARCISSUS: Any of several bulbous flowering plants, of the genus Narcissus, having white or yellow cup- or trumpet-shaped flowers, notably the daffodil.
definitions.OLEANDER: Nerium oleander, a notoriously poisonous shrub in the dogbane family, Apocynaceae, but nonetheless widely grown as an ornamental, having leathery lance-shaped leaves and deep rose-colored or white flowers.
definitions.PRIMROSE: A flowering plant of the genus Primula.
definitions.SNAPDRAGON: Any plant of the genus Antirrhinum, with showy yellow, white or red flowers.
definitions.VERBENA: Verbena, a genus of herbaceous plants of which several species are extensively cultivated for the great beauty of their flowers; vervain.
definitions.WISTERIA: Any of several woody climbing vines, of the genus Wisteria, native to the East Asian countries of China, Korea, and Japan and the eastern United States.
definitions.ANEMONE: Any plant of the genus Anemone, of the Ranunculaceae (or buttercup) family, such as the windflower.
definitions.BUTTERCUP: Any of many herbs, of the genus Ranunculus, having yellow flowers; the crowfoot.
definitions.CHRYSANTHEMUM: Any of many flowering perennial plants, of the genus Chrysanthemum, native to China, that have showy radiate heads.
definitions.FOXGLOVE: Digitalis, a genus of about 20 species of herbaceous biennials native to the Old World, certain of which are prized for their showy flowers.
definitions.GERANIUM: Any flowering plant of the genus Geranium, the cranesbills, of family Geraniaceae.
definitions.HOLLYHOCK: Any of several flowering plants of the genus Alcea in the Malvaceae family.
definitions.IMPATIENS: Any of various ornamental plants of the genus Impatiens.
definitions.LARKSPUR: Any plant of the genera Delphinium or Consolida.
definitions.NASTURTIUM: The popular name of any of the plants in the Tropaeolum genus of flowering plants native to south and central America.
definitions.PERIWINKLE: Any of several evergreen plants of the genus Vinca with blue or white flowers.
definitions.SWEETPEA: A flowering plant, Lathyrus odoratus, grown for its bright colours and sweet fragrance.
definitions.WALLFLOWER: Any of several short-lived herbs or shrubs of the Erysimum genus with bright yellow to red flowers.
definitions.WATERLILY: Any of various members of the Nymphaeaceae family that are tuberous plants, rooted in soil with leaves (lily pads) and flowers floating on the water surface.
definitions.BLUEBELL: Various flowering plants with blue, usually pendulous, flowers.
definitions.COLUMBINE: Any plant of the genus Aquilegia, having distinctive bell-shaped flowers with spurs on each petal.
definitions.CORNFLOWER: A small annual plant in the family Asteraceae, Centaurea cyanus, usually with bushy blue flowers which grows natively in European cornfields (i.e. wheatfields).
definitions.COWSLIP: A low-growing plant, Primula veris, with yellow flowers.
definitions.EDELWEISS: A European perennial alpine plant, Leontopodium alpinum, with downy leaves and small white flower heads in a dense cluster.
definitions.GOLDENROD: Any tall-stemmed plant principally from genus Solidago (also Oligoneuron), usually with clusters of small yellow flowers.
definitions.HONEYSUCKLE: Any of the many species of arching shrubs and climbing vines of the genus Lonicera in the Caprifoliaceae family, many with sweet smelling, bell shaped flowers.
definitions.MISTLETOE: Any of several hemiparasitic evergreen plants of the order Santalales with white berries that grow in the crowns of apple trees, oaks, and other trees, such as the European mistletoe (Viscum album) and American mistletoe or eastern mistletoe (Phoradendron leucarpum).
definitions.NIGHTSHADE: Any of the poisonous plants belonging to the genus Solanum, especially black nightshade or woody nightshade.
definitions.PROTEA: Any of many South African flowering plants, of the genus Protea, having colourful cone-shaped flower heads.
definitions.POINSETTIA: A plant, Euphorbia pulcherrima, with rather small and insignificant flowers but large brightly coloured leaves.
definitions.SNOWDROP: Any of the 20 species of the genus Galanthus of the Amaryllidaceae, bulbous flowering plants, bearing a solitary, pendulous, white, bell-shaped flower that appears, depending on species, between autumn and late winter or early spring, all native to temperate Eurasia.
definitions.VALERIAN: A hardy perennial flowering plant, Valeriana officinalis, with heads of sweetly scented pink or white flowers.
definitions.VERONICA: The image of Jesus's face believed to have been made on the cloth with which St Veronica wiped his face as he went to be crucified.
definitions.WINDFLOWER: An early spring flowering species of the family Ranunculaceae, Anemone nemorosa.
definitions.YUCCA: Any of several evergreen plants of the genus Yucca, having long, pointed, and rigid leaves at the top of a woody stem, and bearing a large panicle of showy white blossoms.
